sections.bodyString:
America loves chocolate ice cream, and so do we! Breyers Chocolate Ice Cream is made with Non-GMO sourced ingredients like fresh cream, milk, and sugar and is also gluten-free. And that flavorful chocolate satisfying your taste buds? That’s real cocoa we use in every ice cream tub. It's the chocolate ice cream of your dreams, rich and creamy with just the right amount of sweetness. When William Breyer started his small ice cream business in Philadelphia in 1866, he based his recipes around simple and pure ingredients. More than 150 years later, we still honor that same philosophy. Ben & Jerry's Cherry ice cream pint with cherries and fudge flakes. It’s our tribute to guitarist Jerry Garcia and his fans everywhere, and it all started with a piece of fan mail. You see, back in the day, before smartphones and social media, our fans spoke to us via handwritten notes pinned to the bulletin boards at our Scoop Shops. It was sometime in 1986 when one such fan was persistent enough to mail a postcard to our main office in Burlington, Vermont. Super premium ice cream meets great guitar solos? It was genius, and Ben immediately began creating the iconic concoction. Cherry Garcia debuted in 1987 and quickly became one of our top three most popular flavors. In fact, the first eight ice cream pints went straight to Mr. Garcia himself and were met with two thumbs up! As for the fan who sent the anonymous postcard? Our sleuths found her and thanked her with a trip to Vermont and a year’s supply of Ben & Jerry’s ice cream. It’s been a long, strange trip ever since, but what remains is Ben & Jerry's commitment to producing the world’s best frozen desserts in the most responsible way possible. Like all of our flavors, Cherry Garcia is kosher ice cream, made with non-GMO sourced ingredients, cage-free eggs, and Fairtrade certified cocoa, sugar, and vanilla. Responsibly sourced packaging gets the goodness from our Vermont factory to your freezer.

If you can think of a more strawberrily perfect flavor combination, let us know because we think this is tough to beat. Think of your favorite creamy cheesecake, topped with sweet fruit (but not too sweet), backed by a light crust. Now, that’s a heavenly dessert. And guess what? For strawberry cheesecake lovers who’ve always wanted to have their cheesecake and scoop it, too, we’ve created a flavor jam-packed with strawberry cheesecake-greatness and a fantastic graham-cracker swirl. Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream pint features big delicious chunks of chocolate chip cookie dough surrounded by creamy vanilla ice cream. It seems like such a no-brainer today, but in 1984 it was revolutionary. The Cookie Dough you know and love started with a simple suggestion: What if you put chunks of chocolate chip cookie dough into vanilla ice cream? That was the wonderful anonymous idea submitted way back in the early days of our first Burlington, Vermont, USA, Scoop Shop. We used to have a bulletin board where people could suggest new flavors for Jerry and Ben to make—and this idea stood out. The folks at the Scoop Shop immediately went to work mixing up a batch of Cookie Dough. It was an instant hit. Initially, the flavor was only available at the Scoop Shop. When we decided to sell it in tubs, we had to figure out how to get that familiar cookie-dough taste, consistency and texture at ice cream temperatures. We teamed up with Rhino Foods and, over an incredible six-year journey, we perfected the cookie dough found in our tubs today. In 1991, Cookie Dough began appearing in freezer aisles everywhere. It has remained one of our most popular and beloved flavors ever since! Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream pint is made with non-GMO sourced ingredients, cage-free eggs, and we get our cocoa, sugar and vanilla from Fairtrade certified producers. We also use responsibly sourced packaging. So dig in!

Ben & Jerry's chocolate ice cream pint, gooey marshmallow, caramel swirls and fudge fish. It’s delicious, but how did it come to be? 

Ben had been pondering the lack of a good marshmallow ice cream for years. “Most attempts at marshmallow were wispy. You can see the white streaks, but you can't taste them, you can't feel them, you can't experience the true glorious marshmallowness of it all,” Ben remembers. Well, back in 1995, we suggested to the rock band Phish that we celebrate our shared Vermont, USA, roots by creating a Phish flavor. As the wheel started turning on the collaboration, Ben saw an opportunity to solve the marshmallow conundrum once and for all. Starting with a base of rich chocolate ice cream, he and our flavor gurus started bringing the band test tubs of the evolving concoction. “We ate many test tubs around the table with Phish. We’ve done flavors with other artists and entities, but nobody was more involved in creating the flavor than Phish was,” Jerry says. The band was instrumental, for example, in calling for caramel swirl, an addition that pushed the flavor over the top. 

We work with Fairtrade certified producers for cocoa, sugar and vanilla. All of Ben & Jerry's ice cream is made with non-GMO sourced ingredients and cage-free eggs. Ben & Jerry’s uses responsibly sourced packaging. "

Ben & Jerry's Chubby Hubby Vanilla malt ice cream pint with peanutty fudge-covered pretzels with fudge & peanut-buttery swirls. This pint is packed to the brim with the very best combination of fudge-covered pretzels, swirled through with fudge and peanut butter. With a name like that, are you surprised that Chubby Hubby is a decadently delightful frozen treat? Chubby Hubby has been around since 1994, so it’s gotten easy to take its sweet, cuddly presence in your life for granted. But what if we told you that the flavor wouldn’t exist without the two prankster co-workers who decided to convince their Ben & Jerry’s-loving boss that there really was a flavor called “Chubby Hubby?” (There wasn’t. At least back then.) After he scoured freezer case after freezer case for the made-up flavor, those pranksters started feeling a little guilty. So, they whipped up the first batch of the now-beloved fudge-pretzel, peanut butter and vanilla malt-flavored ice cream at home. Their boss loved it, and we loved it here at Ben & Jerry’s, too, welcoming it into our family with wide, wide-open arms. We can also wrap our arms around Chubby Hubby’s ingredients and the way it’s made. Like all Ben & Jerry's ice creams, Chubby Hubby uses Non-GMO sourced ingredients, eggs from cage-free hens, and the cocoa, sugar and vanilla are all Fairtrade certified. It's packaged up in a responsibly sourced container, this pint is too good to take for granted.

sections.bodyString:
Vanilla. Chocolate. Strawberry. All in one!? And with no sugar added? Oh, my! The Breyers take on the classic Neapolitan— Strawberry Chocolate Vanilla Ice Cream treat— is the best of 3 worlds with the added bonus of no sugar added! Our Signature vanilla, chocolate and strawberry Breyers frozen dairy dessert come together in one delicious package. Whether one at a time or all three in a scoop, there’s a frozen treat for everyone! Breyers No Sugar Added Vanilla Chocolate Strawberry is even made with Non-GMO sourced ingredients! But it’s not just any frozen dessert, it’s Breyers, so you’ll know that it’s made with high-quality ingredients like sun-ripened California strawberries, real cocoa, and 100% sustainable vanilla from Madagascar! We try to find even the highest quality milk and cream to use in our desserts. Our milk and cream are 100% Grade A from American cows not treated with artificial growth hormones*. When our founder, William Breyer, started his ice cream operation in 1866 in Philly, he was very concerned about the quality of the ingredients that he put into his ice cream. At the time, it was novel to take a stand behind using the best milk, cream, sugar, and fruit. Some 150 years later we still follow his commitments to using high-quality ingredients to make great tasting ice cream. If you are looking for a no sugar added ice cream treat, give Breyers No Sugar Added Vanilla Chocolate Strawberry a try and let us know at www.breyers.com! 
* The FDA states that no significant difference has been shown between dairy derived from rBST-treated and non-rBST-treated cows.

• Breyers No Sugar Added Vanilla Chocolate Strawberry frozen treat is made with fresh cream, real cocoa, and sustainably farmed strawberries!  No Sugar Added!

• This frozen dessert is made in accordance with our Breyers Pledge, starting with high-quality ingredients.
 
• The flavors and colors in Breyers ice cream and frozen desserts are from natural sources.
 
• The fruit and vanilla in Breyers frozen treats is real and sustainably farmed.

sections.bodyString: More unites us than divides us. Our black raspberry ice cream is purple! Deep purple. Brilliant purple. Rich and extraordinary purple. When we think about purple and the United States, we think not only of the purple mountain majesties where these delicious barries grow, but our highest hopes for our country’s identity. We’re not a country split into red states or blue states. That's a way of keeping us separated. Keeping us divided. We are more than, we are better than that. We see our country as fifty purple states-complex and distinct, with different histories, stories and dialects, but ultimately united in a belief that travels across every state border. A vision that has the power to stretch from sea to shining sea. A belief that can unite neighbors and be championed by Main Street, Wall Street, urban metropolises and small, rural towns. The idea that the beauty, strength and greatness of America does not stem from a singular race, religion, creed or culture but from the principle that, All of us are created equal, endowed by our Creator with certain unalienable rights, that among these are life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness. Hopefully our black raspberry ice cream can play a small, delicious reminding us to remain steadfast against the tides to identify ourselves as red or blue and embrace our identity as Americans united by The principles of equality that make our country great. E pluribus unum - out of many, one.

sections.bodyString:
Talenti Gelato makes delicious, indulgent gelatos, sorbettos and frozen desserts with special ingredients, crafted just for you. We start with fresh milk and pure cane sugar - absolutely never high-fructose corn syrup, to craft our frozen dairy desserts. We then add the finest ingredients sourced from all around the world and slow cook the gelato to slightly caramelize the flavors for a one-of-a-kind tasting experience. And because we don’t add extra air into the product, you’ll enjoy a richer flavor with the denser consistency of real Italian gelato. For Talenti's Vanilla Caramel Swirl gelato frozen dessert, we source our vanilla beans from Madagascar and slow cooked in milk and cream for a caramelized vanilla gelato base. All of this makes for the most pure, intense vanilla gelato. After we have our deep vanilla base, we swirl in our signature Argentine dulce de leche. We get our dulce de leche from our friend Mario's mom's recipe from Argentina. Argentinian dulce de leche is like caramel, but richer and creamier. Even better, all our treats are milk-based rather than cream-based, so they are lower in fat. We package it in clear, recyclable, BPA-free jars to keep it fresh and to give you a peek inside. When you’re done, reuse the clear pint jar anyway you like. Try all our gelato flavors and discover your favorite!

Ben & Jerry's Vanilla ice cream pint. Yes, that’s the only ingredient. Would you really want your favorite pint of vanilla to include anything else? When you dig into this pint, you’ll find a rich, creamy Vanilla that’s more vanilla-tasting than any Vanilla you’ve ever tasted. That makes sense, though because we’ve always been of the opinion that Vanilla should never be plain vanilla, if you know what we mean. Our Vanilla has a complexity that may surprise you. But there's more to our Vanilla ice cream than its incredible beyond-homemade taste. It's consciously concocted with a particularly flavorful Fairtrade vanilla blend, including vanilla made from beans grown and harvested by small-scale farmers in Uganda. They're members of local farmer associations that support sustainable farming practices. The premiums we pay for their quality vanilla help them reinvest in their families and communities for a positive change. To us, that makes every scoop all the sweeter. Talk about a win-win: Delicious ice cream and a better world. The cocoa, sugar, bananas, coffee, and vanilla in Ben & Jerry’s ice cream comes from Fairtrade certified producers. Our ice cream and frozen desserts contain Non-GMO sourced ingredients and eggs from cage-free hens, and our packaging is always responsibly sourced.

Ben & Jerry's Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert and certified vegan pint with cherries & fudge flakes. We've kicked our Non-Dairy flavors up a notch with an OAT-standing new recipe. Prepare for this creamy, legendary, OAT of this world concoction. This flavor is our tribute to guitarist Jerry Garcia fans everywhere, and it all started with a piece of fan mail. You see, back in the day, before smartphones and social media, our fans spoke to us via handwritten notes pinned to the bulletin boards at our Scoop Shops. Sometime in 1986, one such fan mailed a postcard to our main office in Burlington, Vermont. Ben & Jerry's meets great guitar solos? We loved the idea, and Ben immediately began creating the iconic concoction. Cherry Garcia debuted in 1987 and quickly became one of our top three most popular flavors. But just as every good musician has to evolve, Ben & Jerry's does, too. So in answer to queries from all of those air-guitar heroes who can’t or choose not to eat dairy, we decided it was time to create this fan favorite into a non-dairy, and it's 100% vegan. It’s made with smooth and creamy OAT milk, which is the perfect blank canvas for the cherries and fudge flakes we pack into this pint. Same euphoria, minus the dairy—and here’s hoping it inspires at least a few soulful guitar riffs. Like all of our flavors, Cherry Garcia non-dairy is a gmo free and uses Fairtrade certified cocoa and vanilla. If that’s not enough, we went one step further to gain 100% vegan diet certification. All the flavor is wrapped in responsibly sourced packaging, so you can feel good about what’s in your freezer.

Is this a peanut-buttery version of our famous Half-Baked creation, or a full-fledged non-dairy P.B. & chocolate concoction filled with fudgy brownies and peanut butter cookie dough? Yes! Instant gratification might get a bad rap - according to your folks, things were way harder in the old days - right?! - but there’s something about peanut butter that just satisfies the second it hits your tongue. The nutrition-minded among us claim it’s the protein in those peanutty-peanuts; the science-minded say it’s the dopamine in your brain that’s triggered by sweet flavors…whatever. Here at Ben & Jerry’s, we know that the feeling you get when you dig a spoon into creamy chocolate and peanut-butter deliciousness packed with brownies and PB cookie dough is simply good old-fashioned euphoria, electrifying your body from taste buds to toes. Did you get that? It’s all about the euphoria. And that whole thing about instant gratification being bad for you? Fudge-getaboutit! Our non-dairy fans have waited long enough to scarf down their pints of Ben & Jerry’s - we’re not going to stand in between them and euphoria. (Would you?!) And hey, not like our non-dairy folks need another reason to love this half-baked pint of peanut-buttery non-dairy perfection - but can we just say: Fairtrade-certified sugar, cocoa, and vanilla? How about non-GMO ingredients, all wrapped up in sustainable packaging? Or 100% vegan diet certified? (‘CUZ we just did.)

sections.bodyString:
Ben & Jerry's Vanilla non-dairy frozen dessert and certified vegan with gobs of chocolate chip cookie dough and fudge flakes. We know how much you love Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough. We love it too… Honestly, we didn’t think we could love it any more than we already did. But we were wrong! Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough has been making people happy ever since 1984, when fans came from all over to our Burlington, VT, Scoop Shop for a taste. Then, when we started selling it in pints, the happiness grew and grew, and it became one of the most popular flavors in Ben & Jerry’s history. Well, we’re dough-lighted to announce that our Non-Dairy Cookie Dough is ready to bring a bunch of new smiles to a bunch of new faces. Our Flavor Gurus are always thinking of ways to make life more fun and delicious, and they’ve outdone themselves this time. They reimagined a treasured fan favorite, ensuring that this classic dough-loaded concoction will make even more people happy. All those gobs of cookie dough, all those giant chunks of chocolate—yes, all the euphoric goodness is there, but it’s 100% dairy free ice cream! As if that weren’t enough, we also use only Fairtrade Certified cocoa, sugar, and vanilla in every pint. We’re proud to use Fairtrade Certified ingredients. After one bite, we bet you’ll understand why!

sections.bodyString:
Est. Brooklyn 2008. A life without anything good is bad. Ever since 2008, when Van Leeuwen was born out of a yellow truck on the streets of NYC, we've been making good ice cream from good ingredients that makes you feel good. After all, happiness is healthiness. And nothing makes us happier than this vegan strawberry shortcake ice cream. With cold-ground vanilla, jam from Oregon-grown strawberries, and pieces of shortcake, eating vegan isn't just better for the planet, it's better for the mouth. This isn't vegan ice cream it's ice cream that happens to be vegan. Why should omnivores get all the good stuff? They shouldn't. That's why we keep our vegan ice cream simple. Because ice cream doesn't have to be complicated. In fact, it shouldn't be complicated. Just don't put a bunch of junk in it. So in our vegan ice cream, you'll find the same type of quality ingredients you'll find in our classic ice cream. See? No matter what your diet is, a life without anything good is bad.

sections.bodyString: Est. Brooklyn 2008. A life without anything good is bad. Why French ice cream? Eggs. Plenty of 'em. Turns out, when you use twice as many egg yolks as standard ice cream you have to call it French Ice Cream. Fine by us. Because whether it's using more eggs or having to legally change our name, we'll do anything to make the best ice cream (French Ice Cream) on Earth. Because a life without anything good is bad. Ever since 2008, when Van Leeuwen was born out of a yellow truck on the streets of NYC, we've been making good ice cream from good ingredients that makes you feel good. After all, happiness is healthiness. And nothing makes us happier than this Honeycomb Ice Cream. Despite being called honeycomb, it's not made from any honey at all. It's made with caramel candy. That all might seem confusing until you realize that ice cream is also made without ice. Your whole life has been a lie. - Ben, Pete & Laura.

Ben & Jerry's Vanilla Non-Dairy frozen dessert and certified vegan pint with chocolate chip cookies, chocolate sandwich cookies & chocolate cookie swirls. A cookie lover’s dream, this frozen dessert treat has it all — except the dairy! (Don’t let the name fool you, it’s 100% dairy-free!) Fans have been asking us for a dairy-less version of our Milk & Cookies flavor for some time now, and we’ve finally gotten the recipe just right. For this pint, our Flavor Gurus used sunflower seed butter to get the creamy texture that you expect from Ben & Jerry’s. They found that it made the perfect neutral starting point for even the most challenging flavors. So, cookie lovers, rejoice! Dig in to this pint of cookie nirvana with two different types of cookie chunks, plus a chocolate cookie swirl that you could follow for days. Share with a friend or two, or keep it all to yourself (seriously, we can’t blame you). After all, sharing might mean that they snag all the chocolate sandwich cookies, and that’s a risk you may not be willing to take. Ben & Jerry's “Milk” & Cookies Non-Dairy is 100% vegan certified and is made with non-GMO sourced ingredients, including Fairtrade Certified cocoa, sugar, and vanilla. If you’re looking for delicious, you’ve found the perfect frozen dessert. Talenti Cookies and Cream Gelato Layers is our unique take on one of our favorite childhood treats. This is our twist on the classic cookies and cream ice cream dessert layered with our signature dulce de leche. We start with a layer of cookies and cream gelato​, a layer of chocolate cookie pieces, followed by​ dulce de leche​ (caramel sauce), a layer of vanilla gelato​, and a final layer of chocolate cookie crumbs. At Talenti, we believe that only the best process and ingredients result in delicious gelato and sorbetto. That’s why we source the highest-quality ingredients from all around the world and use a slow-cooking method (similar to how French chef's use a bain-marie water bath technique) for our frozen dessert. Then we package our products in clear, BPA-free jars that can be recycled and reused any way you like. For clever ideas on how to reuse the pint, check out #Pintcycling on Instagram. In addition to Talenti Gelato Layers, Talenti has Gelato, Dairy-Free Sorbettos, and Organic Gelato flavors to fit all your frozen dessert needs. All of our products are made with non-GMO sourced ingredients that have been evaluated by Where Food Comes From, Inc., and adhere to our Non-GMO Sourced Standards. Check out Talentigelato.com/nongmo to learn more. Talenti also does not use high fructose corn syrup in any of our frozen dessert products. Try all our flavors and discover what makes Talenti so special.

sections.bodyString:
The Talenti Gelato Layers Bakery Collection offers you the comforting flavors of homemade desserts without the baking or the dishes! Our Chocolate Chip Cookie Batter Gelato is a unique twist on the classic cookie dough ice cream flavor making it the perfect frozen treat. We begin with a layer of rich chocolate chip cookie batter gelato, followed by crunchy shortbread cookie pieces. Next, experience the nostalgic taste of gooey cookie batter, reminiscent of licking the bowl after making cookies at home! Creamy Madagascar vanilla gelato follows, and it all finishes with a satisfying layer of chocolate cookie pieces. At Talenti, we believe the best process and highest quality ingredients result in the best tasting gelatos and sorbettos. Our gelato flavors start with fresh milk and cream, and we make each flavor from scratch with the highest-quality ingredients sourced from all around the world. We prioritize quality and sustainability. That is why we’re committed to using ingredients sourced from non-GMO crops, ensuring every spoonful is as wholesome as it is delicious. Moreover, we carefully slow-cook our gelato in small batches, using the finest ingredients ensuring a rich and authentic taste every time. With every recipe--making it the perfect frozen dessert, Talenti adds a twist to make each pint extra special. With a spoon or in an ice cream cone, enjoy your gelato with confidence! All our gelato frozen desserts are packaged in clear BPA-free plastic ice cream pints so when you've finished your jar, you can reuse it #Pintcycling or recycle it (rinse and replace the lid first)! In addition to our Gelato Layers Bakery Collection, Talenti has mini bars, classic Gelato, Dairy-Free Sorbettos, USDA Certified Organic Gelato and flavors that are gluten-free, Egg-free and/or vegan. All our flavors are made with non-GMO sourced ingredients. ** Try all our flavors and discover why Talenti is Crafted for Taste!

• BAKERY COLLECTION: Enjoy the flavors of homemade desserts straight from your freezer, giving you the indulgence of a fresh-baked treat in a frozen dessert without the hassle of baking
 
• UNIQUELY CRAFTED: Dedicated to craftsmanship, we slow-cook our gelato in small batches, using the finest ingredients from around the world to create each flavor from scratch
 
• NO GMOS: We are committed to using only ingredients sourced from non-GMO crops, ensuring the highest quality and integrity in every product we make so you can enjoy it confidently
 
• RECYCLED PACKAGING: Our pint jars are made from 100% recycled plastic and are recyclable and reusable

If you’re looking for something that's both delicious and refreshing, you’ve found the perfect frozen dessert. Talenti Caribbean Coconut Gelato is our unique take on the classic coconut ice cream flavor for a refreshing frozen treat. Talenti makes delicious, indulgent gelatos and sorbettos with special ingredients, crafted just for you. It may not be a trip to the tropics, but delighting in this pint is almost as good! We start with fresh milk, cream and pure cane sugar (never any high-fructose corn syrup) to make our coconut gelato base. Next, we add pure coconut sourced from the Philippines to bring out the intensity of the flavor for a one-of-a-kind tasting experience. We finish it off with tender coconut shreds, and you’ll be amazed by the perfect texture and light sweetness. And because we don’t add extra air into the product, you’ll enjoy a richer flavor with a denser consistency like true Italian gelato. We package it in clear, recyclable, BPA-free pint jars to keep it fresh and to give you a peek inside. When you’re done, reuse the jar anyway you like. Deliciously gooey marshmallow swirled through rich chocolate Breyers and real almond pieces. Breyers Rocky Road is the fastest road to fun! Love Breyers chocolate ice cream as a frozen dessert? Well, this frozen dairy dessert, made with rich cocoa, will be sure to be your new favorite. Our philosophy is to start with the high-quality ingredients to make great-tasting ice cream and frozen dairy desserts. In our Breyers Rocky Road frozen treat, we start with 100% Grade A milk and cream from American cows not treated with artificial growth hormones*, colors and flavors from natural sources**, and sustainably farmed fruit and vanilla**. Our commitment to high-quality ingredients comes from our founder, William Breyer, who in 1866 made a Pledge of Purity for his homemade ice cream business in Philadelphia. He had a philosophy of using only the best, and we also believe that the quality of our ingredients makes delicious ice cream and frozen dairy desserts. Give it a try and leave us a review at Breyers.com or follow us @Breyers on Instagram! * The FDA states that no significant difference has been shown between dairy derived from rBST-treated and non-rBST-treated cows. ** Our product, before the inclusion of any candies, cookies, sauces, or fruit from other suppliers, will fully abide by this claim. Raspberries are not sustainably farmed.

sections.bodyString:
Nothing beats our butter-roasted pecans and creamy Breyers vanilla dessert. So good, it is nuts! The pecans in this frozen dairy dessert were roasted in butter and then surrounded by delicious Breyers vanilla dessert. Back in 1866, when William Breyer started his small ice cream business in Philadelphia, he probably would have been seen as nuts to use the ingredients that he did. He valued great ingredients so much that he committed his ice cream to a pledge of purity, telling the world that only the best milk, cream, fruit, and other ingredients would do. Now, some 150 years later, we still follow the same commitments to using high-quality ingredients in our desserts. Our Breyers Butter Pecan is made with 100% Grade A milk and cream that come from cows not treated with artificial growth hormones*. We use flavors and colors from natural sources** and 100% sustainable vanilla. We believe that the quality of our ingredients makes delicious desserts, and that’s why even today we keep true to William Breyer's pledge of purity. Try it yourself and leave us a review on Breyers.com or follow us @Breyers on Instagram! *The FDA states that no significant difference has been shown between dairy derived from rBST-treated and non-rBST-treated cows. **Our product, before the inclusion of any candies, cookies, sauces, or fruit from other suppliers, will fully abide by this claim.

There’s a flavor for everyone in this box of delicious and refreshing fruit pops, with each ice pop containing only 15 calories, 0 g of saturated fat and 0 g of sugar. This box of sugar free ice pops is perfect for any occasion; serve it at a party or just keep it in the freezer for an easy frozen dessert. Popsicle Ice Pops have been a treasured American treat for over 115 years, and they are a family favorite ice pop. In 1905, when he was 11 years old, Frank Epperson invented the first ice pop. One night, Frank poured soda powder into water and mixed it with a stirring stick. He accidentally left the mixture outside all night in the cold, waking up the next morning to find that his drink had frozen like an icicle. This ice pop was a hit with his friends, and a classic was born. Be sure to try our other products in the Popsicle family and discover your next favorite frozen treat!

Fudgsicle is part of the Popsicle family, which has been offering treasured American treats for over 115 years. In 1905, when he was 11 years old, Frank Epperson invented the first ice pop. One night, Frank poured soda powder into water and mixed it with a stirring stick. He accidentally left the mixture outside all night in the cold, waking up the next morning to find that his drink had frozen like an icicle. This ice pop was a hit with his friends, and a classic was born. Be sure to try our other products in the Popsicle family and discover your new favorite frozen dessert. If you love the taste of our Fudgsicle No Sugar Added Fudge Pops, try our other varieties of the classic fudge pop.

Wishing summer could be here all year long? No problem. We’re bringing your favorite ice cream truck treat right to your freezer. Popsicle SpongeBob SquarePants frozen dessert treats bring you the magic of a frozen dessert in a fun SpongeBob shape that you will love. You don’t need to live in a pineapple under the sea to get all the excitement of your favorite cartoon in the form of a delicious frozen treat. These delightful Popsicle frozen confection bars feature mouthwatering fruit punch and cotton candy flavors - and at 50 calories per bar, you might not want to stop at just one. Our Popsicle SpongeBob bars are colored with natural sources. Popsicle ice pops have been a treasured American treat for over 100 years and remain America's favorite ice pop. In 1905, an 11-year-old boy, Frank Epperson, invented the first ice pop. One night, Frank poured soda powder into water and mixed it with a stirring stick. He accidentally left the mixture outside all night in the cold. Frank awoke the next morning to find his drink was frozen like an icicle. It was a hit with his friends and a classic was born. And now you get to reap the benefits with our full line of delicious Popsicle treats!

sections.bodyString:
In 1916, two young Polish immigrants named Nathan and Ida Handwerker put down their $300 life savings to open a frankfurter and french fry stand on Conney Island, New York. They called it Nathan's Famous! In addition to selling the country's newest taste sensation, the hot dog, Nathan and Ida served golden, crinkle cut french fries. Nothing like ordinary fries, these were made from fresh-peeled potatoes, cut thick and hearty with a unique, crinkly shape, and cooked to a crispy golden brown perfection. Today, Nathan's Famous hot dogs and crinkle cut fries are served the world over with exactly the same integrity and care. And now, you can enjoy the great taste of Nathan's Famous hot dogs and French fries right in your home!

Wake up and give your taste buds a bite of that good morning feeling! Jimmy Dean Delights Egg’wich Breakfast Sandwiches are the perfect way to enjoy a lighter, but still delicious breakfast with the family every morning. Crafted with savory chicken sausage and melty cheese layered between two frittatas flecked with broccoli and cheese, these delicious sandwiches kickstart your and your family’s mornings and help fuel the day ahead. sections.bodyString: Ritter Sport Gourmet Dark Chocolate Bar (30% Cocoa) with Whole Hazelnuts. FOR BITERS. NOT FOR SUCKERS. Treat yourself to the irresistible crunch of RITTER SPORT Dark Chocolate with whole crunchy roasted hazelnuts from Turkey. Whole crunchy roasted hazelnuts from Turkey, chosen specifically for their 11-13 millimeter diameter, are fully ripened for an intense nutty taste. These premium hazelnuts are put through a two-stage 2 stage selection process – including hand selection. sections.bodyString: In 2013, childhood friends Peter Rahal and Jared Smith joined forces to create a protein bar made with as few ingredients as possible. In an industry oversaturated with protein bars filled with ingredients that no one could pronounce, Rahal identified a core of real, simple ingredients to use (egg whites, dates, and nuts), which are still used in almost every RXBAR product today. Since then, the company has expanded its offerings to kids bars, nut butter and oats. Continuously striving to make products better, RXBAR will always put the needs and desires of its customers first to help make eating healthy more accessible and convenient to all.

No preservatives. Just the best tortilla chip. Volcanic stone ground corn. Naturally good. Our Story: After years of enjoying fresh corn tortillas and chips shipped from my wife's hometown in Mexico, I decided it was time to share this authentic experience with you. In 2011, we opened Tortilleria Mi Nina the first tortilla bakery in New England that authentically produces tortilla chips from true corn masa. This process is known as Nixtamal, a technique that originates from the Aztec Period. Our masa is produced by cooking whole grain non-GMO corn with nothing else but filtered water and mineral lime. Beauregard Sweet Potato: Cultivated by an entomologist in Louisiana and once one of the most widely available varieties in the U.S. Recently it has been replaced by varietals such as the Covington. Yukon Gold: Cultivated in Canada and introduced to the world in 1980. Yukon Golds are highly regarded for their beautiful golden color and intense flavor. sections.bodyString: Botanically brewed. Traditional. Est. 1905. Gateshead Tyne & Wear. North East England. After a fellow tradesman welshed on a loan, iron puddler Thomas Fentiman found himself in possession of a secret process for brewing a smashingly good Ginger Beer. His quintessentially British beverages quickly became one of Europe’s most renowned effervescent refreshments. More than 100 years hence, Fentimans continues to tantalize persons of discerning taste across the continents. Unfiltered: Up-end bottle to gently invigorate for naturally superior flavor. Young Arthur and Edith Fentiman deliver unique refreshments door-to-door at the early part of the century. In the early 1900s, Fentimans began its seven-day brewing and fermentation process, creating its time-honoured recipe for success. Today, we continue this tradition by using only the finest ingredients, squeezing the juice of one and a half lemons into every bottle and blending it with fine ginger root, speedwell, and juniper extracts. Not more than 0.5% alcohol by volume.

Carbonated water, lemon juice concentrate, fermented ginger root extract (water, glucose syrup, ginger root, pear juice concentrate, yeast), beet sugar, glucose syrup, pear juice concentrate, cream of tartar, natural flavors (lemon, orange), herbal infusions (speedwell, juniper berry)

Indulge in a cup of Chock full o’Nuts coffee, where each sip delivers a rich, smooth, and aromatic coffee experience. Made from premium Arabica beans that are carefully hand-selected, these coffee pods ensure a balanced flavor without bitterness. This medium roast coffee pod is designed for those who appreciate quality in every cup. Whether starting your day or taking a midafternoon break, these coffee pods promise the heavenly taste for which Chock full o’Nuts has been renowned since 1932. These single serve pods provide convenience without compromising taste. Perfect for both homes and offices, each pod offers a quick and easy solution for your coffee cravings without the fuss of traditional brewing. Imagine the pleasure of savoring a delightful cup of coffee any time of the day. Enjoy the tradition of Chock full o’Nuts, a trusted name that brings its legacy of high-quality coffee from its original New York City shop to the global stage. It's time to transform your coffee experience with Chock full o’Nuts, where every cup promises satisfaction and eco-conscious brewing. 
 
• ARABICA COFFEE: Chock full o’Nuts Coffee is made from premium Arabica beans, carefully selected to ensure top-quality taste and aroma. Sourced from the finest growing regions in the world, these beans are roasted to perfection, delivering a consistently rich and smooth coffee experience.
 
• FANTASTIC FLAVOR: Every sip of Chock full o’Nuts Midtown Decaf Medium Roast provides all the flavor you need from a great coffee, without the caffeine. The carefully roasted beans produce a rich, aromatic brew that’s satisfying from the first taste to the last drop
 
• K-CUP PODS: Designed for effortless brewing, Chock full o’Nuts single serve pods are engineered for guaranteed quality and compatibility with all Keurig single serve coffee makers. These pods offer a hassle-free way to enjoy a fresh, flavorful cup of coffee at home or in the office
 
• RECYCLABILITY: Simple. Delicious. And recyclable*. Enjoy the same great-tasting coffee you know and love, and when you’re done, just peel, empty, and recycle.  Enjoy great coffee while making an environmentally conscious choice. *Check locally, not recycled in many communities.
 
• OUR STORY: Since 1932, Chock full o’Nuts has been a trusted name in coffee, known for delivering expertly roasted, aromatic blends. What began as a small shop on Broadway in New York City has grown into a beloved brand enjoyed by coffee lovers everywhere
Coffee

sections.bodyString:
Spring Water
There are over 326 million trillion gallons of water on earth, but only 1 billionth of 1% is crisp and refreshing enough to be called Deer Park. Our water is sourced from springs that span across and around the Eastern Seaboard and beyond.
What Is Spring Water Anyway?
Great question. According to the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA): “Spring Water is water derived from an underground formation from which water flows naturally to the surface of the earth at an identified location.” To be able to label our product as “spring water,” we have to satisfy stringent standards — standards we proudly meet or exceed. That’s why every bottle of Deer Park Brand water is labeled as natural.
When Deer Park Brand Spring Water got its start near the crest of the Appalachians, travelers came from all over to enjoy a taste of the water. Today, our natural spring water comes from carefully selected spring sources in five states. We're still honored to serve folks across the region and call this beautiful place our home.

This Asian-inspired beverage blends the vibrant flavors of the Indian Alphonso Mango with carbonated water, creating a delightful drink that is both delicious and healthy. Our Mission:

At Sanzo, we are dedicated to celebrating and sharing the rich and diverse flavors of Asia. Our mission is to bridge cultures by bringing authentic Asian flavors to the world, using only the best ingredients. Enjoy a taste of Asia with every sip of Sanzo sparkling flavored water.

Why Choose Sanzo Mango Sparkling Water?

Choose Sanzo Sparkling Waters for a refreshing and healthy beverage that celebrates the unique and authentic flavors of Asia. Whether you're enjoying it on its own, with a meal, or as a mixer, Sanzo offers a delicious and guilt-free alternative to sugary carbonated drinks, connecting you to the vibrant tastes of the Eastern hemisphere.

Today, there are so many more ways to enjoy the great taste of Canada Dry. • FAST ACTING BOOSTS: 5-hour ENERGY® shots are quick and easy to take and pack a 230mg boost of caffeine. No mixing or shaking required. Your next boost is ready for long commutes, busy days, study sessions, and your pre-workout or exercise routine.
 
• CONVENIENT & CRAVEABLE: These delicious energy shots are portable and travel ready. They fit in your bag, car, or desk drawer for an on-the-go ready-to-drink boost. A non-carbonated partner for your next long workday, gaming marathon or gym session.

And now you can take that Snapple Kiwi Strawberry flavor with you with our 8 oz, 8-pack bottles made with recycled plastic material for easy, on-the-go refreshment. Snapple always brings the flavor. That's what we have been doing ever since we were a small brand created by three friends in the New York area. We started out by selling our apple juice to health clubs in 1973. Since then, we have expanded our flavor portfolio throughout the 80s into teas, fruit drinks, and lemonades. Snapple went national in the early 90s, and now you can find us in more than 30 flavors and in all 50 states across the country. And for an extra dose of fun, don't forget to check out our Snapple 'Real Facts' under our caps!

sections.bodyString: Pipe icing, frosting, batter and more with these standard 12 in. Disposable Decorating Piping Bags. Great for piping whipped cream, buttercream frosting, royal icing, ganache, or meringue batter, these decorating bags are designed for quicker and easier decorating. You can even use them for savory recipes, such as filling deviled eggs, making twice baked potatoes or filling stuffed shells. These piping bags work best with standard Wilton piping tips (sold separately) but can also be used with large piping tips or without a tip. When you're done, simply toss the bag for easy, stress-free cleanup! One package includes twelve 12 in. decorating bags.

How to prepare decorating bag: To use bag without a coupler, simply drop decorating tip into bag with the narrow end of the tip down and trim bag to fit tip. To use bag with a coupler, trim bag with scissors to accommodate coupler base. Twist ring off coupler base and drop (narrow end first) into bag. Push coupler base as far down into bag and with a pencil; mark the spot on the outside where the bottom thread is outlined against the bag material. Remove coupler and cut across the mark. Replace coupler in bag and push through bag opening. One thread should be showing. Position decorating tip on outside of bag over coupler base. Twist on ring to hold tip in place. For more ideas and inspiration, visit wilton.com.

sections.bodyString: Bring the rich, buttery sophisticated taste of caramel to your drinks with this Torani Caramel Sauce. This coffee syrup and dessert sauce will authentically deliver the flavor you are craving with the clean, pure and simple ingredients you demand. Torani Puremade Caramel Sauce adds just the right amount of authentic burnt brown sugar taste found in artisan caramel. Featuring a thicker consistency, this flavoring syrup is great as a caramel syrup for coffee, specialty coffee drink, or mocha, as well as a flavoring sauce for dessert cocktails and shakes. Made with real, simple ingredients like Dutch cocoa, caramelized sugar, fresh cream, and no artificial flavors, colors or preservatives, Torani Puremade Syrups are perfect for drinks and desserts. These decadent sauces are also GMO-free and gluten-free. Combine our wide selection of sauces to create unique dessert toppings and custom flavors: Premium ingredients like caramelized sugar allow the flavor to come through, even when paired with the bitter taste of espresso. Expertly crafted to complement beverages, Torani Sauces deliver the rich flavor that perfectly blends in coffee and frozen drinks. With Torani Puremade Sauces, you can create drinks without artificial ingredients and emulsifiers. It’s amazing flavor without compromise. In 1925, Rinaldo and Ezilda Torre create hand-crafted syrups from recipes brought over from Lucca, Italy to the North Beach neighborhood in San Francisco, California. By 1933 and the end of Prohibition, Ezilda was one of the first female rectifiers of distilled spirits in the US. She led Torani through the Great Depression and WWII. In 1982 our Vanilla syrup was used in the first flavored latte. We started with just five syrups and have since grown to a portfolio of over 150 sold around the globe. sections.bodyString: Quality with integrity. No toxic additives. Perfect for brewing fresh coffee. Designed for 8-12 cup coffee makers. Healthy home. Healthy planet. Healthy you. Those are big promises but you can't have one without the others, so here's our thinking. Like it or not, we are all intimately connected within our world. Choices we make affect us all, even the choice of coffee filters we use in making coffee. If you care about your choices, so do we. And when we care, we all benefit. Chlorine: We use unbleached, totally chlorine free (TCF) paper, eliminating the risk of chlorine residues entering the watercycle where it can have harmful long-term ecosystem effects. Lifecycle: Globally, millions of tons of valuable biobased materials go to landfill, where they remain useless and worse, produce greenhouse gasses that accelerate climate change. Composting. Our coffee filters are compostable so they return organic material to our ecosystem. Micro fauna get a good meal and produce soil-enriching, life-giving compost that locks up carbon, contributing to soil health, ready for the next generation of life. It all adds up to our circle of life moments. Lovely thought. Fits 8-12 cup coffee makers.

Carolina Whole Grain Thai Fragrant Brown Jasmine Rice is the secret ingredient to crafting wholesome and delicious meals. Whether you’re preparing a weeknight meal, a side dish or a sweet dessert, our gluten free rice is the perfect starting point. Its versatility allows you to create everything from comforting dishes that remind you of home to more refined culinary creations. Carolina has been trusted by American families for over 100 years, providing consistent quality and flavor in every bag.
Brown Jasmine Rice

Cooking tips: Preparing Aromatic Brown Rice Rice: Dress it Up! The versatility of rice is just one of its key benefits. Below are simple ways to make aromatic brown rice even more special. Starting with hot, cooked rice •Sprinkle with fried scallions, shallots, garlic or ginger. •Add grated lemon zest, chopped fresh mint, a dab of butter and cooked peas. •Stir in peanut butter and chopped scallions; sprinkle with chopped peanuts. •Stir in grated Parmesan cheese and sauteed onions. •Season with toasted sesame oil or tamari. •Stir in chopped dried fruit and toasted nuts. When preparing rice •For perfect pilafs, saute rice in oil to firm and toast the starchy exterior. •Saute garlic, add rice and cook in chicken broth. •Substitute a combination of chicken broth and white wine for water. •Cook rice with a few saffron threads; stir in cooked peas. •Cook with shiitake mushrooms for an earthy, smoky flavor. Here are some quick tips for cooking with Thai Brown Jasmine: •Seasonings typically paired with jasmine rice include: lemongrass, cilantro, hot chilies, fish sauce, limes or lemons, basil, coconut milk, nuts, fruits, garlic, shallots and hot and flavorful curries. •Adding lemon peel shortly before rice has finished cooking gives it a light, bright flavor. Cooking directions on the stove. 1. In a saucepan, bring water to boil.* 2. Stir in rice.** 3. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until all water is absorbed. **Add 1 Tbsp, butter and 1 tsp, salt per cup of uncooked rice, if desired. *Cooking measurement chart. Rice 1 cup 2 cups 3 cups Water 1- 1/2 cups 2- 3/4 cups 4 cups Yield 3 cups 6 cups 9 cups Servings ( 3/4 cup cooked) 4 8 12 For drier rice, use 1/4 cup less water. For moister rice, use 1/4 cup more water. Cooking directions in the microwave***. 1. In a 2-quart microwave-safe dish, combine 2- 1/2 cups water and 1 cup rice. 2. Cover and microwave on high for 25 minutes. Remove from microwave let stand for 5 minutes. ***It is recommended that only 1 cup rice be prepared in the microwave at a time. Microwave ovens vary. Cooking times are approximate.

sections.bodyString:
The origins of Angel Hair, with their evocative name (fine hair) and light consistency, are contested between the area around Genoa, Naples and the Ciociaria (central Italy). It is one of the thinnest types of long pasta wound into a nest shape. Even the name Angel Hair is reminiscent of the fine consistency of this type of pasta which is ideal for infants from 9 months old onwards to help them get used to eating food for grown-ups. Simple condiments are recommended for this type of pasta. It is excellent combined with butter dressings, such as uncooked butter and cheese, or melted butter with sage and cheese. Egg or fresh raw tomato based sauces are also excellent. Another way to enjoy Angel Hair is in a light, chicken broth. In addition to broths and pasta dishes with sauces, this pasta is also used to prepare oven-baked dishes in the Naples region.

sections.bodyString: Bring a taste of New Orleans to every meal with Zatarain’s® Black Beans & Rice. Big on flavor and stove-top ready in less than 30 minutes, it’s made with ingredients you can see and taste, including beans, vegetables, and spices. Enjoy it as a side or jazzed up as a meal — just add a 1/2 lb of cooked sausage, chicken, ham, or vegetables. No single culture owns beans and rice — it’s a natural pairing that likely developed independently in different parts of the world. Zatarain’s Black Beans & Rice is rooted in the Caribbean, where the combination of savory black beans and fluffy rice is a daily staple. It’s flavorful but not spicy, and it pairs well with a variety of meats but is also hearty enough to stand alone as a meatless entrée. A New Orleans tradition since 1889, Zatarain’s prides itself on great taste and a near fanatical dedication to New Orleans cuisine. Try our products like rice sides, dinner mixes, pasta dinner mixes, breading, seasonings, seafood boils, spices, and condiments. sections.bodyString:
Enjoy the moment with every spoonful of Oui by Yoplait French Style Black Cherry Whole Milk Yogurt. Pleasure is at the heart of this French style yogurt. It begins with simple ingredients like whole milk and real black cherries, poured into individual glass pots and left to set for eight hours. And voila. . .the culturing process creates a delicious fruit yogurt so thick and creamy, it calls for a proper spoon. So take the time to truly taste. And let your senses be your guide. Enjoy this crafted yogurt cup on a train trip into the city. Take the yogurt jar to the sunniest room at your workplace. Savor spoonfuls as a gluten free snack on a bench outdoors. Each black cherry yogurt is made with live and active cultures and contains no artificial flavors and no colors from artificial sources. Oui yogurt is best experienced without stirring to get just the right amount of fruit from the bottom in every bite. The glass pot protects the delicate, creamy texture while the yogurt sets, as well as during shipping. The result is unparalleled taste and texture for a uniquely French yogurt experience. Oui glass pots are reusable and recyclable. Keep this flavored yogurt cold in the refrigerator until you're ready to pick up a spoon. Say Oui to the French way with Oui French Style Yogurt and Layered Desserts. 
 
• One 5 oz glass yogurt jar of Oui by Yoplait French Style Black Cherry Whole Milk Yogurt
 
• A moment of pure enjoyment in every spoonful
 
• Crafted yogurt inspired by a French yogurt recipe and set in an individual glass pot

• Enjoy this fruit and yogurt jar with gluten free breakfast food or pack Oui yogurt as snacks you can take outdoors

Brown Cow Cream Top Yogurts are reminiscent of the way yogurt used to be made when rich, smooth cream rose to the top. Made with whole milk, our cream top yogurt features sweet cream on top and fruit on bottom. Includes live and active cultures. sections.bodyString:
Est. 1925. Simpler. Better. Plant based. Steams & froths. Beautifully. No added gums or emulsifiers. Meeting for Coffee: When Henry Schwartz met Dr. Cheryl Mitchell, plant-based nutrition changed for the better. Well, actually, the simpler the better. Henry, a converted dairyman, and Dr. Cheryl, a renowned inventor, partnered to create a line of plant milks with fewer ingredients and more nutrition. They named this new brand, Elmhurst 1925, after Henry's family dairy company. Plant milks and coffee are a pair, but baristas are a picky sort, so we blended almonds with rice to craft a product for coffee that steams into the a more flexible microfoam that baristas love. It isn't just for professionals, though. Whether steaming to make a velvety cappuccino, or adding to your morning cup - our barista edition is a six-ingredient, plant-based answer to all of coffee's possibilities. We believe that plant-based milks should taste just like their source. That's why we have only a few simple ingredients in each carton. Simpler is better. Enjoy! 2 in 1 Steamer Creamer: Whether making a perfect microfoam, or adding flavor and texture to your morning cup, we have your coffee needs covered. 0 no added gums or oils. Many other plant-based creamers add gums like gellan, guar, locust bean, lecithin, or carrageenan. We don't, and never will. Carrageenan free. Why do we use dipotassium phosphate? This safe water-soluble salt is less than 2% of our product and provides the performance baristas need. Please recycle. recyclecartons.com. FSC: Mix - Board from responsible sources. www.fsc.org.

Pompeian Smooth Extra Virgin Olive Oil delivers the smooth, mild flavor home cooks reach for every day. First cold-pressed for a light, balanced, buttery taste, this EVOO complements your favorite recipes without overpowering them. Versatile across the kitchen, Pompeian Smooth is ideal for everyday cooking, sauteing, roasting, baking, marinades, salad dressings, dipping bread, drizzling over finished dishes, meal prep, or substituting for butter and vegetable oil in any recipe. From weeknight dinners and roasted vegetables to homemade dressings, dips, and pasta, Pompeian Smooth brings clean, balanced flavor to the dishes you make most.

According to the North American Olive Oil Association (NAOOA), extra virgin olive oil has a smoke point of 350 degrees F to 410 degrees F, making it well suited for everyday cooking methods from sauteing to roasting. Its heart-healthy monounsaturated fats and naturally occurring polyphenols make it a stable olive oil for the kitchen.

A staple of the Mediterranean diet, olive oil is a simple way to bring Mediterranean-style eating into everyday meals and recipes. EVOO contains vitamin E, a natural antioxidant. It also contains vitamin K, which supports bone health. It is a simple, wholesome choice for balanced meals and mindful, healthy eating.

As America's #1 Olive Oil brand, Pompeian has been crafted by The Olive Oil People since 1906 and is 100% Farmer-Owned, sourced from a global network of family farmers who grow, harvest, and cold-press the olives in every bottle. Every batch is certified for authenticity by the NAOOA, ensuring 100% extra virgin olive oil that is never cut with other oils.

Farmer-owned and family-crafted, Pompeian Smooth Extra Virgin Olive Oil is naturally gluten-free, non-allergenic, kosher, and Non-GMO Project Verified, making it a confident everyday choice for home cooks who want quality, versatility, and value in every bottle.
